title: Imaging system, control method of imaging system, and program
abstract: To realize photographing under a predetermined relative position between an illumination part for illuminating a subject area and an imaging part for imaging a subject area, even when the relative positions among the illumination part, the imaging part, and the subject area are not identical for each shot.SOLUTION: An imaging system includes: an illumination part for irradiating a terahertz wave; an imaging part for photographing an image of a subject; and a control part for controlling either the illumination part or the imaging part so that a positional relationship between the illumination part irradiating the subject area and the imaging part photographing the subject area satisfies a predetermined condition, in accordance with a positional relationship between a subject area photographed by the imaging part and the imaging part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Image formation apparatus and processing method
abstract: To provide an image formation apparatus which improves the convenience of setting.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 100-A includes a communication unit 110-A which communicates with another image formation apparatus 100-B via a network and a processing unit 120-A. The processing unit 120-A provides a setting screen, when the setting of the image formation apparatus 100-A is received in the setting screen, reflects the setting on the image formation apparatus 100-A, and reflects the setting reflected on the image formation apparatus 100-A on the other image formation apparatus 100-B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Imaging apparatus
abstract: To provide an imaging apparatus which is high in visibility of a tally lamp.SOLUTION: An imaging apparatus includes: a rotational part that rotates an imaging direction of an imaging part to a pan direction or a tilt direction; and a plurality of tally lamps that indicates any one of an imaging state indicating whether or not an image by the imaging part is performed and a distribution state indicating where or not the image captured by the imaging part is distributed. In a first tally lamp among the plurality of tally lamps, at least one part of the first tally lamp is arranged on a surface positioned in the imaging direction of the imaging part. In a second tally lamp among the plurality of tally lamps, at least one part of the second tally lamp is arranged on the surface positioned in a direction that is reversed to the imaging direction of the imaging part. In a direction orthogonal to the imaging direction of the imaging part, the imaging apparatus is arranged at a position where the imaging part is sandwiched.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Radiation imaging system, program, optical imaging condition setting method, and optical imaging apparatus
abstract: To prevent imaging conditions of a radiation image from causing inconvenience in confirmation or analysis in radiation imaging using an optical image.SOLUTION: A radiation imaging system comprises: a radiation imaging unit which detects radiation applied from a radiation source and having passed through a subject and captures a radiation image; an optical imaging unit for capturing an optical image of an area including an area to which the radiation is applied from the radiation source; and an optical imaging condition setting unit which sets imaging conditions of the optical imaging unit on the basis of imaging conditions of the radiation image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Optical unit, virtual image display device, and method for measuring optical unit
abstract: To facilitate correcting an optical component and facilitate ensuring and improving the quality of a virtual image.SOLUTION: An optical unit 100 and a virtual image display device, which is an HMD 301 include a plurality of optical members 10. The plurality of optical members 10 each have measurement reference members 11 to 15 that provide references related to the arrangement in non-contact parts. The directions of the plurality of measurement reference members 11 to 15 of the plurality of optical members 10 are unified.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: RTO heat accumulation formula incinerator tail gas treatment equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an RTO heat accumulating type incinerator tail gas treatment device which comprises four support columns, a box body, a gas inlet pipe, a gas outlet pipe, a driving motor, a second rotating rod and a cooling mechanism, wherein the box body is arranged at the tops of the four support columns, the box body is provided with a box door convenient to overhaul, the gas inlet pipe is sleeved with one side of the box body, the gas outlet pipe is sleeved at one side of the box body, which is far away from the gas inlet pipe, the driving motor is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the box body, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with the second rotating rod, and the cooling mechanism is arranged at one side of the box body, which is close to the gas inlet pipe; the cooling mechanism further comprises a water tank, a first supporting plate, a first rotating rod, a stirring blade, a hollow box, a fourth connecting pipe, an atomizing spray head, a filter box, a sponge, a filter screen, a sleeve barrel, a box cover, a hose, a triangular block, a movable connector, a water pump, a second connecting pipe and a first connecting pipe, wherein the water tank is fixedly connected to one side, close to the air inlet pipe, of the top of the box body.

title: Flue gas pretreatment denitrification facility
abstract: The utility model discloses a flue gas pretreatment denitration device, which comprises a tripod, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the tripod, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the front side of the cooling mechanism, the cooling mechanism comprises a water collecting tank fixedly arranged at the upper side of the tripod, a cooling cylinder is fixedly connected to the upper side of the water collecting tank, a flue inlet is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the cooling cylinder, a flue outlet is fixedly connected to the front side of the cooling cylinder, an air inlet is fixedly arranged on one side of the cooling cylinder, and an air outlet is fixedly connected to the other side of the cooling cylinder. According to the flue gas pretreatment denitration device, heat exchange is carried out between high-temperature flue gas and low-temperature air entering the inner side of the cooling cylinder, meanwhile, water flows are sprayed out through the spray head to cool the circular pipe in a double-layer mode, the flue gas temperature is stably controlled within a proper range, sintering caused by flue gas catalyst particles is avoided, and therefore the service life and activity of a flue gas catalyst are prolonged.

title: Steam oxidation furnace
abstract: The utility model discloses a steam oxidation furnace, which comprises a furnace body, wherein a cover plate is arranged at the top of the furnace body, a driving motor is arranged at the top of the cover plate, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the driving motor, a plurality of placing discs are arranged on one side of the rotating shaft extending into the furnace body in an array mode, a water tank is arranged at the bottom of the furnace body, a return pipe is sleeved between the water tank and the furnace body, a one-way valve is arranged on the return pipe, a steam channel is sleeved at the top of the water tank, two air blowing pipes positioned in the furnace body are arranged at the top of the steam channel, an air inlet assembly is arranged in the middle of the steam channel, and an electric heating wire connected with the inner wall of the water tank is arranged below the air inlet assembly. The utility model not only can reduce the laying of pipelines and the energy loss in the steam conveying process, but also can conveniently and timely recycle the cooling water, reduce the temperature difference of the cooling water affecting the steam in the furnace body, and is beneficial to the stability of the temperature in the furnace body.

title: Heat supply network hydrophobic recycling system
abstract: The utility model discloses a heat supply network hydrophobic recycling system, which comprises an eighth low-pressure heater, a seventh low-pressure heater, a sixth low-pressure heater and a fifth low-pressure heater which are connected in sequence through a main condensation water pipe, wherein the fifth low-pressure heater is communicated with a deaerator through the main condensation water pipe; the fifth low-pressure heater flows back to the sixth low-pressure heater through the first drain pipe, the sixth low-pressure heater flows back to the seventh low-pressure heater through the second drain pipe, the seventh low-pressure heater flows back to the eighth low-pressure heater through the third drain pipe, the eighth low-pressure heater also flows back to the hot well through the fourth drain pipe, and the hot well is also provided with a condenser; and the sixth low-pressure heater is also connected with a detection unit. The utility model relates to a heat supply network hydrophobic recycling system has solved the hydrophobic recovery energy waste of heat supply network who exists among the prior art and has been forced to shut down the hidden danger, has fine practical value.

title: Closed flue gas condensate water fast discharging anti-blocking device
abstract: The utility model relates to a closed flue gas comdenstion water is arranged soon and is prevented stifled device belongs to gas boiler, energy-conservation and carries effect technique and instrument field. The utility model aims at solving the problem that boiler flue gas comdenstion water drainage is not smooth, easy to block up, causes the rust and corrosion of smoke box bottom portion promptly smoke box tube sheet around the boiler to and because the open emission of flue gas comdenstion water, cause the inside moisture in boiler room too big, corrode other equipment in boiler room. The device includes: the device comprises a tank body, a filter plate, a high-pressure spray gun, a ball screw, a pressure gauge, a temperature sensor, a water inlet, a water outlet and a sewage outlet; by adopting the design of the closed tank body and the open pipeline and by monitoring the temperature and the pressure of the flue gas condensate water in the tank body in real time, the invention can effectively solve the problems of unsmooth drainage of the flue gas condensate water of the boiler, easy blockage and rust and corrosion of the bottom tube plates of the smoke box at the front and the rear of the boiler, thereby prolonging the service life of the boiler, reducing the unnecessary energy consumption of the boiler and having positive effects on energy conservation and consumption reduction of a power plant.

title: Nut processing equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a nut processing equipment relates to mechanical equipment technical field, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the fixed mount that is provided with of base top central point department of putting, and the cross-section of mount is the hexagon, the inside both ends swing joint of mount has rather than the matched with slip grip block. The utility model discloses mount overall structure is the hexagon structure, the inside both ends of mount all swing joint have the slip grip block, two sets of slip grip block both sides are all fixed be provided with mount looks sliding connection's slider, it rotates to drive two sets of two-way lead screw simultaneously through two sets of motors, and two sets of two-way lead screw run through two sets of sliders respectively, the rotation of two-way lead screw, make two sets of slip grip blocks can do the slip that is close to mutually or keeps away from mutually, the distance of carrying out between two sets of slip grip blocks can be adjusted, adaptation specification that can be fine is hexagon nut's processing in the certain limit size, the suitability is comparatively extensive, it is comparatively convenient to.

title: Roller car
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of sewing equipment, and discloses a roller car which comprises a workbench, wherein a rotating shuttle structure, a cutting structure for cutting off a thread and a feeding structure for driving a material to move are arranged on the workbench; the workbench comprises a bottom plate, wherein an upright post and a supporting plate are arranged above the bottom plate, the supporting plate is positioned on one side of the upright post, the upper end surface of the supporting plate is higher than the upper end surface of the upright post, and a vertical hole penetrating through the bottom plate is formed in the upper end surface of the upright post; the rotating structure comprises a rotating shuttle shaft which is rotatably arranged in the vertical hole; the feeding structure comprises a feeding sleeve which is rotatably arranged in the vertical hole, and the feeding sleeve is sleeved outside the rotating shuttle shaft; the rotating shuttle shaft, the feeding sleeve and the vertical hole are coaxially arranged, and the rotating shuttle shaft feeding device has the effect of reducing the size.

title: Retention mechanism, transfer device, handling robot system, and unloading device
abstract: To provide a retention mechanism, a transfer device, a handling robot system, and an unloading device that are capable of easily holding an article.SOLUTION: A retention mechanism includes: a base having one end, a structure connection mechanism, a drive part, and a regulation member. The structure connection mechanism includes a connection member for connecting at least two or more structures with the structure, and is rotatable in a first rotation direction about a first shaft, whereas partly restricted in rotation in a second rotation direction about the first shaft. The regulation member is provided at a prescribed distance from the one end. The drive part moves the structure connection mechanism in a first direction from the one end toward the regulation member. According to drive of the drive part, a projection part of the structure connection mechanism projecting beyond the one end projects in a second direction substantially orthogonal to the first direction after passing between the one end and the regulation member. The regulation member regulates movement of the projection part in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Upset pushes down mechanism
abstract: The utility model provides a mechanism is pushed down in upset, it includes: the fixing frame comprises a fixing plate and two mounting plates, and the inner side walls of the lower ends of the two mounting plates are respectively provided with arc chutes which are symmetrical to each other; the pressing assembly comprises a pressing piece, a rotating shaft and a sliding rod, the pressing piece is horizontally arranged between the two mounting plates, the rotating shaft and the sliding rod are vertically arranged at one end, close to the mounting plates, of the pressing piece, two ends of the rotating shaft are respectively connected with the pressing piece and the mounting plates in a rotating mode, one end of the sliding rod is horizontally and fixedly connected with the pressing piece, and the other end of the sliding rod is inserted into the arc-shaped sliding groove and can slide up and down along the arc-shaped sliding groove; the turnover assembly comprises a telescopic element and a connecting frame, the connecting frame is enclosed outside the fixing frame, a strip-shaped groove is horizontally formed in the connecting frame, the sliding rod is inserted into the strip-shaped groove, and the telescopic element is used for driving the connecting frame to move up and down. The utility model discloses a mechanism is pushed down in upset, simple structure, the volume is light and handy, and process flow is simple, and the operating efficiency is high, easily production and use.

title: Big end gluing machine for corrugated pipe
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile part production, in particular to a corrugated pipe large end gluing machine which comprises a frame, a wavy object, a pushing cylinder, a connecting plate, a plurality of pushing plates, a displacement assembly, a clamping assembly, a mounting plate, a motor, a rotating head and a gluing assembly, wherein the wavy object is fixedly connected with the frame and is provided with a plurality of through holes, a first V-shaped groove and a second V-shaped groove, the pushing cylinder is arranged on the frame, the output and the connecting plate fixed connection of pushing away material cylinder, polylith push pedal all with connecting plate fixed connection, and polylith push pedal respectively with corresponding through-hole sliding connection, displacement subassembly sets up in the frame, clamping assembly installs on displacement subassembly, mounting panel and frame fixed connection, the motor is installed on the mounting panel, the output and the rotating head fixed connection of motor, the rubber coating subassembly sets up on the mounting panel to this mode has replaced artifical rubber coating, and has realized continuous rubber coating, has promoted production efficiency.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: To provide an image forming apparatus that can easily connect to a desired server among a plurality of partner servers.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus 10 comprises a reading unit 1, a communication unit 50, and a control unit 60. The reading unit 1 reads an input image of a business card or a staff identity card of a user. The communication unit 50 executes communication via a network 20. The control unit 60 controls the reading unit 1 and the communication unit 50. The control unit 60 specifies a desired partner server related to the user's post from among a plurality of partner servers 11-13 via the network 20 by using at least one of character information and image information based on the input image, and sets information for connection to the desired partner server to the communication unit 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Network device and processing method for network device
abstract: To allow the security of communication to be enhanced.SOLUTION: A network device includes: acquisition means that acquires proxy information set in the network device; and communication means that communicates with a management server via a proxy server using the proxy information if an aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is information received from the proxy server, or if the aggregation mode is not enabled, and that does not communicate with the management server if the aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is not information received from the proxy server.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title: Setting information utilization system, setting information transition method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract: To provide a setting information utilization system that prevents a mistake in an application destination of setting information.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus has a setting information registration unit 32 that registers setting information transmitted from a first electronic apparatus and first identification information for identifying a network that is used when the first electronic apparatus transmits the setting information in association with each other, a specification unit 33 that, in response to an acquisition request for requesting acquisition of the setting information transmitted from a second electronic apparatus, specifies the setting information registered by the setting information registration unit based on the first identification information and second identification information for identifying the network used when the acquisition request is transmitted, and a transmission unit 31b that transmits the setting information specified by the specification unit to the second electronic apparatus.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Image forming system, portable terminal, and program
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology that, in cooperation of an image forming apparatus and a portable terminal with each other, makes it possible to check that the image forming apparatus cooperating with the portable terminal is an image forming apparatus desired by a user. SOLUTION: A portable terminal 50 acquires information (information for specifying apparatus) for a user to determine whether an image forming apparatus that is to cooperate with the portable terminal 50 is a desired image forming apparatus through BLE communication (short-range radio communication) with the image forming apparatus. The portable terminal 50 displays a confirmation message 700 confirming execution of cooperation with the image forming apparatus. The confirmation message 700 includes the information for specifying apparatus (for example, apparatus name "sixth floor, east side 1"). The portable terminal 50 executes the cooperation with the image forming apparatus (for example, authentication operation) according to the user's operation to confirm the confirmation message 700. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 17 COPYRIGHT: (C)2022,JPO&INPIT

title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A-1C COPYRIGHT: (C)2022,JPO&INPIT

title: Compositions and methods for treatment of kidney diseases
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide methods and compositions for increasing the expression of a protein, and for treating a subject in need thereof, e.g., a subject with deficient protein expression or a subject having a kidney disease. SOLUTION: Provided is a method comprising the step of contacting the cells of a subject with an antisense oligomer (ASO), which is complementary to the targeted portion of RIC pre-mRNA encoding a target protein or functional RNA, whereby the retained intron is constitutively spliced from the RIC pre-mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, thereby increasing the level of mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, and in the cells of the subject, increasing the expression of the target protein or functional RNA. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1 COPYRIGHT: (C)2022,JPO&INPIT

title: Anti-her2 combinations for treating cancer
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a therapeutic combination for treating cancer by using combinational therapy. SOLUTION: A therapeutic combination comprises: (i) an effective amount of a Her2/Neu antagonist, such as an antibody or a functional fragment thereof that specifically binds to Her2/Neu (e.g., anti-Her2 antibody); and (ii) an effective amount of an immunotherapeutic that is capable of activating a human plasmacytoid dendritic cell, myeloid dendritic cell, or NK cell, or a combination thereof. SELECTED DRAWING: None COPYRIGHT: (C)2022,JPO&INPIT

title: Chimeric antigen receptor cells for treating solid tumor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide antibodies that bind UPK2 or antigen-binding fragments thereof. SOLUTION: Provided is an antibody that binds UPK2, or an antigen-binding fragment thereof, comprising a heavy chain variable region (HVR) and a light chain variable region (LVR), the heavy chain variable region comprising any of 7 amino acid sequences, each of which is different from each other, the light chain variable region comprising any of 8 amino acid sequences, each of which is different from each other and different from any of the 7 amino acid sequences. The HVR may be linked to a human IgG chain constant region. An antigen-binding domain comprising the antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof may be comprised in a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR). SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1 COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title: Chemical composition and method for using the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a probe for sequencing, a reporter probe and a method in which nucleic acid sequencing that is quickly executed with no enzyme, no amplification and no library, and has a low error rate with a long read-out length. SOLUTION: A probe including a primary nucleic acid molecule which hybridizes with at least six secondary nucleic acid molecules, in which each of the plurality of secondary nucleic acid molecules hybridizes with at least five tertiary nucleic acid molecules, and each of the tertiary nucleic acid molecules includes at least one detectable label. SELECTED DRAWING: None COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title: Power Amplifier Circuit
abstract: To provide a power amplifier circuit that improves distortion characteristics and efficiency by forming a bypass path for high-frequency components.SOLUTION: A power amplifier circuit 101 comprises: a distribution circuit 41 that distributes an input signal RFin with a phase difference applied; a carrier amplifier 51 that outputs a first amplified signal RF4; a peak amplifier 52 that outputs a second amplified signal RF5; a combiner circuit 42 that combines the first amplified signal and the second amplified signal to generate a third amplified signal RFout; a first bias circuit 151 having a first bias supply terminal 151a that supplies a first bias to a second terminal of a first capacitor 61 through a resistor element 160; a second bias circuit 152 having a second bias supply terminal 152a that supplies a second bias to a second terminal of a second capacitor 62 through a resistor element 162; and a third capacitor 64 having the first terminal connected to the second capacitor 62 and the second terminal connected to the first bias supply terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Bias circuit and radio frequency power amplifier
abstract: The utility model discloses a bias circuit and a radio frequency power amplifier, which belong to the technical field of high-power lasers, wherein the bias circuit comprises a programmable digital-to-analog conversion module, an enabling signal end of the module is respectively connected with one end of a filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 and one end of a voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , the other end of the filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 is grounded, an external enabling signal is connected with the external enabling signal through the other end of the voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , and the external enabling signal is input to the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module after voltage stabilization and capacitance filtering, so that the output voltage of the module can be stabilized, the precision requirement of digital-to-analog conversion is ensured, the precision control of the required bias voltage is realized, and the stability and the precision of the bias voltage are further ensured. Meanwhile, when the power amplification chip changes, parameters of the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module can be flexibly adjusted. Based on the method, the complexity of the bias circuit can be reduced and the flexibility of the bias circuit can be improved on the premise of ensuring stability and accuracy.

title: Slope feedback control circuit and micro-processing chip
abstract: The application provides a slope feedback control circuit and a micro-processing chip. The slope feedback control circuit comprises a driving circuit, a detection circuit, a constant current circuit and an LIN bus, wherein the driving circuit comprises a driving tube and a first capacitor, a first input end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a control end of the driving tube, a second input end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a transmitting signal end, an output end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a first input end of the constant current circuit, a second input end of the constant current circuit is electrically connected to the transmitting signal end, an output end of the constant current circuit is electrically connected to the control end of the driving tube, a first end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to the control end of the driving tube, a second end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to a first voltage end, an input end of the LIN bus is electrically connected to the second end of the first capacitor and the first end of the driving tube, and the LIN bus is electrically connected to the second end of the first capacitor and the first end of the driving tube. The application improves the reliability of signal detection.

title: Miniature DI input detection method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a miniature DI input detection method and device, the method comprises the steps that an input module obtains passive or active switching value signals and transmits the signals to an input detection protection module, the input detection protection module carries out signal conversion and detection on the switching value signals, different voltages are obtained according to different input switching value signals and output to an output control module, and the output control module outputs and obtains the level of a current switching value conversion output result according to different voltage values output to the output control module. The invention establishes a set of miniature DI input detection device with low power consumption, high reliability, low cost and small volume through simple separation components, and realizes compatible input detection of passive switching value and active switching value through the device.

title: Signal processing device
abstract: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Stirring system of baking-free bricks
abstract: The utility model relates to a non-burning brick raw material mixing technical field especially relates to a non-burning brick's mixing system. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: (mixing) shaft, casing, bottom plate and notes material subassembly, bottom one side fixed mounting of casing has the unloading pipe, and the bottom fixed mounting of unloading pipe has the protection casing, and one side fixed mounting of casing has notes material subassembly, annotates and installs the controller in the material subassembly, and one side electric connection of controller has the cable conductor, and five solenoid valves are installed to the output of cable conductor. The utility model discloses a combination of various structures makes this device install the solenoid valve in one side of casing, can provide fixed mounting's position to the subassembly on every side through the solenoid valve to can control the switch of pan feeding pipe, and then can send the material into five groups of agitator tanks respectively, make the material mix the stirring step by step, and then can promote the mixed effect of the inside each component of non-burning brick combined raw materials, and then promoted the mixing efficiency of device.

title: Tea cleaning and drying integrated equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses tea cleaning and drying integrated equipment which comprises a mechanical box body, wherein a lifting device is movably arranged in the mechanical box body, drying devices are fixedly arranged at two ends of the lifting device, and a rotating device is fixedly arranged in the mechanical box body. Above-mentioned scheme places the fixed plate in the inside of sealing the frame, through the effect of joint spring, with joint bolt joint in the inside of sealing the frame, the side that will clear water pass through the functional box simultaneously, will wash the pond and annotate fully, at this moment, the clear water overflows the bottom of rolling the net section of thick bamboo, through starting rotary drive, make the surface of the inside tealeaves of rolling the net section of thick bamboo drive in aqueous rotate the washing, start fan subassembly and resistance heating wire, make drying device exhaust hot-blast, dry the both ends of rolling the net section of thick bamboo, after the stoving, take out the tealeaves of drying, wash stoving an organic wholely, when saving occupation space, the process of reduction personnel operation, save time and manpower, the practicality of improvement equipment.

title: Environment-friendly energy-saving quartz sand tailing deep processing pickling device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of pickling devices, and discloses an environment-friendly and energy-saving quartz sand tailing deep processing pickling device, which is characterized in that a second sliding cavity is arranged on the side wall of an opening of a pickling cylinder of the pickling device, a second filter screen is slidably connected in the second sliding cavity, a first sliding cavity communicated with the opening is arranged in the side wall of the pickling cylinder, an arc-shaped stop block is rotatably connected in the first sliding cavity, the side end of the arc-shaped stop block is fixedly connected with a first slide block, the side end of the second filter screen is fixedly connected with a second slide plate, a stirring blade is fixedly connected on a rotating shaft connected with the output end of a motor, the tailings with different volumes are separately pickled, a collecting tank is arranged on the bottom surface of a pickling tank and is communicated with the pickling tank through a guide pipe, a first closed door is rotatably connected on a first opening corresponding to the pickling tank on the pickling tank, a second closed door is rotatably connected on a second opening corresponding to the collecting tank on the pickling tank, so that the discharged waste liquid is treated to reduce subsequent work.

title: Fixation machine for chrysanthemum processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a fixation machine for chrysanthemum processing, which comprises a fixation bottom plate, a second turnover mechanism and a first turnover mechanism; a green removing bottom plate: the upper end of the water-removing box is fixedly connected with a water-removing box, the left end and the right end in the water-removing box are both rotationally connected with conveying rotating shafts, the four conveying rotating shafts distributed at four corners are in transmission connection through a conveying belt, the upper ends of the top wall and the front and rear side walls of the water-removing box are both provided with snake-shaped steam injection pipes, and the inner side surfaces of the snake-shaped steam injection pipes at the front and rear sides and the bottom end of the snake-shaped steam injection pipe at the upper end are both provided with evenly distributed air injection holes; the second turnover mechanism: which is fixedly connected with the right side of the top wall of the fixation box; the first turnover mechanism: it is arranged at the left side of the fixation box; wherein: still include steam generator, steam generator is located the front side of the bottom plate that completes, and this chrysanthemum processing is with machine that completes, and turn over many times can guarantee to chrysanthemum can the biggest area with the heat transfer source heat transfer, and the effect of completing is better.

title: Dry ladle desulfurization equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of fruit and vegetable fresh-keeping storage and discloses a dry ladle desulfurization device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the front side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a desulfurization box, the rear side of the desulfurization box is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the top of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a driving assembly, the front side of the driving assembly is fixedly connected with a beating head, the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the desulfurization box are fixedly connected with support plates, and the left side and the right side of the top of each support plate are fixedly connected with limiting columns. According to the utility model, the wet dry ladle is placed in the desulfurization box, and then hot steam is introduced into the air inlet pipe, so that the dry ladle can be heated and desulfurized, and then the motor is started, so that the output end of the motor drives the output shaft to rotate, and then the output shaft drives the beating head to beat the vibrating plate when rotating, so that the dry ladle vibrates, and then the dry ladle can be heated uniformly and desulfurized more thoroughly.

title: Preparation method for novel compound
abstract: The present application relates to a preparation method for a novel compound, in which there are advantages that when a compound is prepared using the preparation method of the present application, the yield is high and the reaction time is reduced.

title: Diphenylalkane compound and preparation method, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, relates to a diphenylalkane compound, a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, and particularly discloses a diphenylalkane compound shown as a formula (I) and 1-fluoro-3-methoxy-5-phenethyl benzene (II), a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicines for preventing or treating metabolic syndrome. The compound has obvious antimetabolite syndrome effect, and can be applied to the clinical treatment of antimetabolite syndrome in the form of monomer or medicinal composition.

title: Resist composition, method for producing resist pattern, and compound
abstract: To provide a compound, a resist composition and the like which allow a resist pattern having good CD uniformity to be produced.SOLUTION: There are provided: a compound represented by formula (I); a resist composition; and the like. [In the formula, R5A and R5B each represent -X2-R10 or the like, X2 represents -CO-O-, -O-CO-O- or the like, R10 represents a group containing an alicyclic hydrocarbon group having one or more substituents, at least one of the substituents is -OR11 or an -I group, and R11 represents a hydrogen atom or an acid-labile group; L1A, L1B, L2 and L3 each represent a single bond or a substituted/unsubstituted alkanediyl group; X3 represents -O-, -CO- or the like; Ar1 and Ar2 each represent an aromatic hydrocarbon group; R3 and R6 each represent a halogen atom, a haloalkyl group or a hydrocarbon group; m2 represents 1-6 and m3 and m6 represent 0-5, provided that 1≤(m3+m6)≤10 and the compound of formula (I) has one or more halogen atoms; and m4 and m5 represent 0-5, provided that 1≤(m4+m5)≤10.]SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivatives, preparation method therefor and use thereof
abstract: A pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivative, and a preparation method and medical use thereof are provided. The pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivative shown in general formula (I), a preparation method of the derivative, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the derivative, and use of the derivative or salt as a therapeutic agent, especially as a rearranged during transfection (RET) inhibitor, are provided.

title: Irreversible fap inhibitor and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of medicine, relates to an irreversible FAP inhibitor and a use thereof, and a use of the compound in a drug for diagnosing and/or treating tumors, rheumatoid arthritis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, atherosclerosis, myocardial infarction, liver fibrosis, pulmonary fibrosis, and renal fibrosis, and in particular to a compound represented by formula I, or an isomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or metal complex thereof, and a use thereof. Substituents in formula I have the same definitions as those in the description.

title: Method for producing four-season meju with lactic acid bacteria and beneficial bacteria that reduces the harmful factors of traditional soybean paste
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing lactic acid bacteria (beneficial bacteria) four-season fermented soybean lump reducing risk factors in traditional fermented sauces realized with: a raw material and auxiliary raw material bringing-in step; a selection and washing step; an immersion step; a steaming step; a starter inoculation step; a grinding step; a compression and molding step; a fermentation step; and a drying step, wherein the manufactured four-season fermented soybean lump have a remarkable effect of developing the traditional fermented soybean lumps industry into a competitive industry by making the allowable range of apratoxin and biogenic amine, which are risk factors, meet domestic and international standards.

title: Functional plant solid beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a functional plant solid beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the functional plant solid beverage comprises the following components in percentage by mass: the sea-buckthorn health beverage is prepared from 15% of sea-buckthorn, 15% of white mulberry, 12% of dandelion, 12% of polygonatum odoratum, 12% of rhizoma polygonati, 30% of black fruit micromolecule peptide, 1% of riboflavin and 3% of monosaccharide, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing the following components in percentage by mass: sea-buckthorn, white mulberry, dandelion, polygonatum, rhizoma polygonati, black fruit small molecular peptide, riboflavin and monosaccharide; baking fructus Hippophae, Mori fructus, herba Taraxaci, rhizoma Polygonati Odorati, rhizoma Polygonati, small molecular peptide of fructus Nicandrae, riboflavin, and monosaccharide at low temperature for more than 24 hr; and putting the baked components into a high-speed powder grinding machine according to the weight part ratio for wall breaking treatment, and sieving by a sieve of 80-100 meshes to obtain superfine mixed powder. The invention can quickly and effectively dissolve fat and thrombolysis, reduce cholesterol and supplement various trace elements required by human body.

title: Panda source Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides panda source Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 and application thereof. The panda source Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 was deposited at the microorganism strain collection of Guangdong province at 2023, 3 and 14 days with the deposit number of GDMCC NO:63205, named: gao Liwei Shewanella (weissella koreensiskk). The strain has good acid resistance and bile salt resistance, and can ensure that enough biomass passes through the stress of the digestive tract environment; the bacteria have surface hydrophobicity and automatic aggregation capability; the extracellular metabolite after fermentation of the strain has the capability of removing DPPH free radical and hydroxyl free radical; the strain can produce feed enzyme preparations such as cellulase, beta-galactosidase and the like; the strain has good inhibition effect and copolymerization collection capability on pathogenic bacteria such as salmonella typhimurium, escherichia coli, staphylococcus aureus and the like. In addition, animal feeding experiments show that the Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 has good application prospects in the aspects of improving the feed value, improving the intestinal health of animals, enhancing the immunity of organisms, improving the meat yield of animals and the like as a probiotic feed additive.

title: High-activity odorless natto product and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-activity odorless natto product, which comprises the following steps: s1, cutting sweet potatoes into blocks or slices, and drying to obtain dried sweet potatoes; s2, soaking the dried potato and the soybeans in the nutrient solution 1, draining, and steaming; s3, peeling soybeans, soaking and washing steamed dried potatoes and peeled soybeans with a nutrient solution 2, and inoculating bacillus natto for three-stage fermentation to obtain a odorless sweet natto product. More importantly, the fibrinolytic activity is improved by about 10 times compared with the traditional natto by adopting special nutrient solution for soaking and three-stage fermentation, and the thrombolytic effect is more remarkable. Therefore, the high-activity odorless natto has remarkable advantages in smell, taste, nattokinase content, fibrinolytic activity and thrombolytic efficacy.

title: Fresh cut flower flowering phase extender containing pullulan and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a fresh cut flower flowering phase extender containing pullulan and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of antistaling agents. The fresh cut flower flowering phase extender provided by the invention comprises pullulan polysaccharide, fulvic acid, potassium chloride and sodium benzoate, and the components act together, so that compared with the existing fresh cut flower flowering phase extender in the market, the fresh cut flower flowering phase extender has the characteristics of small dosage, low cost, cold resistance, heat resistance and lasting effect, and has a good effect of prolonging the fresh cut flower flowering phase within the range of 5-25 ℃. The fresh cut flower flowering phase extender formula does not contain silver salt with strong physiological toxicity and environmental pollution, and is efficient, environment-friendly and environment-friendly; has antibacterial, antiseptic, nutrient supplementing, and water metabolism balancing effects; the preparation method is scientific, reasonable, simple and feasible.

title: Laminate, printed matter, aqueous dispersion liquid, and laminate manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention provides a layered product comprising a release layer that can be formed from an aqueous coating liquid, that is quickly released from the substrate when alkaline treatment is performed, and that has excellent water resistance. The layered product of the present invention is a layered product comprising a release layer on a substrate, the release layer comprising a granular carboxylic anhydride-modified olefin resin and a binding part containing an acid group-free thermoplastic resin, the carboxylic anhydride-modified olefin resin having an average particle size of 0.5 to 20 μm, the binding part having a thickness of 0.25 to 20 μm, and the release layer having an actual acid value of 100 mg KOH/m 2 or more.

title: Resin composition, sheet-like laminate material, printed wiring board, and semiconductor device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a resin composition providing a cured article having low dielectric loss tangent, high mechanical strength, and high adhesiveness. SOLUTION: There is provided a resin composition containing (A) a resin having a thermosetting functional group FA, (B) a resin having a radical polymerizable functional group FB, and (C) a resin having a functional group FA' reactive with the thermosetting functional group FA and a functional group FB' reactive with the radical polymerizable functional group FB, and the number n a of the functional group FA' of the (C) component when the number of the thermosetting functional group FA of the (A) component is 1, and the number n b of the functional group FB' of the (C) component when the number of the radical polymerizable functional group FB of the (B) component is 1, satisfy 0.01≤n a ≤200 and 0.01≤n b ≤400. title: Polymer film
abstract: To provide a polymer film which is excellent in static bending characteristics, folding characteristics and transparency, and holds excellent optical physical property and mechanical physical property even under high temperature and high humidity.SOLUTION: A polymer film contains a polymer resin selected from the group consisting of a polyamide-based resin and a polyimide-based resin, and has a haze (HZ0) before autoclave treatment of 3% or less, and ΔHZ24 value represented by the following expression of 500% or less. In the expression, HZ0 means a haze before the film is treated by an autoclave, HZ24 is a haze after the film has been treated by the autoclave, and the autoclave treatment is treatment at wet heat at 120°C and a pressure of 1.2 atm for 24 hours.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Matte brightening agent for providing leather surface protection and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of leather finishing, and particularly relates to a matte brightening agent for protecting the surface of leather and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials comprise 30-40 parts of the self-extinction type water-based polyurethane resin, 20-40 parts of the polyurethane resin, 0.2-0.8 part of the flatting agent and the like. The product is prepared by a gradient rotating speed mixing and stepwise feeding process, and the product has excellent ageing resistance and solvent resistance by utilizing the synergistic effect of the resin and the organosilicon modified microspheres, has 60-DEG glossiness of less than or equal to 1.0, has soft hand feeling and antibacterial function, can meet the requirements of high-end scenes such as automobile interior leather, solves the problems of higher glossiness, insufficient weather resistance and the like of the existing product, and is suitable for various leather substrates.

title: Antifogging article and production method of the same
abstract: To provide an antifogging article excellent in water scale-removing property, suppressing elusion of a hydrophilic agent, and excellent in antifogging property.SOLUTION: The problem is solved by adopting an antifogging article based on the hydrophilic property of a water-absorbing resin, which comprises: a water-absorbing resin coat comprising a cured product of a water-absorbing resin composition containing a water-absorbing polyol having an oxyethylene unit as the repeating unit, and an acrylic polyol; a hydrophilic agent; a colloidal silica; and a base material having the coat on the main surface.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Pressure-resistant device and fluid pressure cylinder
abstract: To improve molding accuracy and durability of a pressure-resistant device.SOLUTION: A cylinder 100 includes: a cylinder bottom 120 which has a base part 121 and an annular wall part 122 protruding from the base part 121 and in which the wall part 122 is joined to a cylinder tube 110 to close an opening of the cylinder tube 110; a back ring 140 which is provided facing at least one of an inner peripheral surface 110b of the cylinder tube 110 and an inner peripheral surface 122b of the wall part 122 and which determines a relative position between the cylinder tube 110 and the cylinder bottom 120; and a groove part 124 formed on an inner surface of the cylinder bottom 120. The groove part 124 has: a first groove part 124a formed on the inner peripheral surface 122b of the wall part 122; and a second groove part 124b which is continuous with the first groove part 124a and formed on a bottom surface 121a of the base part 121.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Fluid manifold and method of making the same
abstract: To provide a fluid manifold with improved performance.SOLUTION: A body 110 of a fluid manifold 100 includes a proximal end 112, a distal end 114, and a primary manifold component 120. The primary manifold component extends from the proximal end of the body to the distal end thereof and encloses a primary channel 122. The fluid manifold may further include at least one auxiliary manifold component 130. The at least one auxiliary manifold component diverges from the primary manifold component and encloses an auxiliary channel 132 connected to the primary channel at a primary channel exit port. The fluid manifold may further include at least one compression valve region. The compression valve region may be operable between an open position and a closed position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title: Narrow frame moves and carries anchor clamps
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted industrial control, in particular to a narrow-frame transfer clamp. It at least comprises a connecting plate; the surface of the bottom plate is provided with an electromagnetic valve, one side of the electromagnetic valve is provided with a gas distribution block, the side surface of the bottom plate is provided with a plurality of flexible clamping jaws, the electromagnetic valve is connected with the gas distribution block through a pipe body, and the gas distribution block is connected with the flexible clamping jaws through gas pipes; the rotary cylinder is fixedly arranged on the connecting plate, and the output end of the rotary cylinder is connected with the bottom plate; the inside of spout is equipped with the slider, and the slider is located the inboard slip of spout, and the slider can slide along in the spout. The flexible clamping jaw is used for clamping and positioning the side edges, the transferring is not limited by the size of the frame, the transferring of the narrow frame and the ultra-narrow frame of the glass cover after the glue scraping can be met, the full-automatic process is realized without being limited by a sucking disc, meanwhile, the instability of the small suction nozzle in the transferring process is avoided, and the product yield and the production efficiency are improved.

title: Passivation equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a passivation device, comprising: the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a mounting frame, and the front end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating handle; the connecting rod is fixedly connected to the lower end of the connecting frame, the lower end of the connecting rod is connected with a connecting block, and the lower end of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a passivation box; the mounting block is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the bottom plate, and a fixing rod is fixedly connected inside the mounting block; the ultrasonic generator is fixedly arranged on the left end face of the inside of the passivation box, and the right end of the ultrasonic generator is fixedly connected with a plastic soft board; the liquid discharging pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the lower end of the passivation box, and an electromagnetic valve is fixedly connected to the inside of the liquid discharging pipe. The passivation equipment has the advantages of high reaction rate and high reaction efficiency, is convenient for moving the internal passivation metal, and solves the problem that the contact part of the object plate and the passivation metal of the conventional passivation equipment is difficult to effectively passivate.

title: Screw pump structure with good sealing performance
abstract: The utility model discloses a screw pump structure that sealing performance is good, concretely relates to screw pump technical field, including pump case and universal joint, one side of pump case is provided with the discharge chamber, the opposite side of pump case is provided with the drive shaft, one side fixedly connected with shaft coupling of drive shaft, one side of shaft coupling is provided with the transmission shaft, be provided with supplementary speed reduction structure between shaft coupling and the transmission shaft. The utility model discloses a be provided with mechanical seal, seal ring, sealing plug and suction chamber, the screw pump is when not using, fill in the sealing plug to suction chamber's inside and can effectively prevent dust, reduce the possibility that the pollutant is attached to on the suction indoor wall, when starting up the screw pump like this, the medium is transmitted from the sealing plug, it is more smooth and easy, internals also obtains better protection, seal ring has strengthened driven leakproofness and stability with mechanical seal, reduce the friction, can effectively prevent the outside seepage of medium, it is also very convenient to install and maintain.

title: Molecular sieve membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a molecular sieve membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the membrane thickness of the molecular sieve membrane is 10-500 mu m, preferably 30-200 mu m. The invention provides a preparation method of a molecular sieve membrane, which comprises the following steps: a) Preparing a colloid slurry from molecular sieve seed crystals, a silicon source, water, optionally an aluminum source, optionally a colloid stabilizer; b) Uniformly dispersing the colloid slurry on the surface of a carrier framework, and drying to obtain a blank; c) And (3) carrying out heat treatment on the green body in the presence of organic amine to convert the surface coating of the green body into a molecular sieve membrane. According to the method, the thickness of the molecular sieve film can be effectively adjusted, meanwhile, the organic amine solution and the coating slurry are prepared separately, and the coating slurry can be repeatedly used; the crystallized organic amine solution can be repeatedly used or recycled because of almost no chemical change, so that the amount of waste mother liquor is greatly reduced, and the method is particularly suitable for industrial production.

title: Preparation method and application of metal precursor self-limiting domain type Ni single-atom electrocatalyst
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a metal precursor self-limiting domain type Ni single-atom electrocatalyst. The electrocatalyst presents a three-dimensional nano-sheet morphology and has a rich mesoporous structure, and mainly comprises Ni, N and C, wherein the Ni exists in a single atom form. The Ni loading of the catalyst is 1-2wt%, the specific surface area is 200-450 m 2 /g, and the average pore diameter is 5-10 nm. The preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) fully mixing a metal precursor NiZnAl LDHs with an ethanol solution of o-phenanthroline to form a solution A, fully mixing chitosan with an acetic acid aqueous solution to form a hydrosol B, and 2) mixing the solution A with the hydrosol B, and then obtaining the electrocatalyst through freeze drying, inert atmosphere heat treatment, air oxidation, acid etching and secondary inert atmosphere heat treatment. The catalyst is simple to operate, low in cost and controllable in process, and can be applied to electrocatalytic CO 2 reduction reaction, and high catalytic activity and product CO selectivity are shown.

title: Dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material for hexavalent chromium-containing sewage treatment and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material for hexavalent chromium-containing sewage treatment, which comprises the following steps: growing a polypyrrole nanowire loaded three-dimensional electrode material on a three-dimensional anode; adding aniline into sulfuric acid, adding a polypyrrole nanowire loaded three-dimensional electrode material, uniformly stirring, and cooling to 4-5 ℃; adding ammonium persulfate into sulfuric acid at the temperature of 4-5 ℃, stirring, and immediately adding into the solution in S2 to obtain a mixed solution; and after stirring, standing and reacting for 24-25 hours in an environment of 4-5 ℃ to obtain the dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material. The invention also discloses the dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material and application thereof. The dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material has larger specific surface area, can provide more reactive sites, improves the current efficiency and the reduction efficiency, and is suitable for high-flux and high-concentration treatment of large-scale industrial Cr (VI) sewage.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method of preparing a nanomaterial and nanomaterial prepared by the method, the method comprising: a. preparing a carbon dot solution; b. uniformly mixing a silicon source, an active center source, organic alkali and optional water to obtain a first mixture; c. mixing the carbon dot solution with the first mixture to perform hydrolysis reaction to obtain a second mixture; d. and carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the second mixture, collecting a solid product, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the nano material. The nano material disclosed by the invention has excellent catalytic activity in the phenol oxidation reaction, and meanwhile, the catalytic stability and repeatability are good.

title: Magnesium-aluminum hydrotalcite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite material and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the field of nano materials, and the magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite material with small bulk density (less than or equal to 0.22g/cm 3 ), high specific surface area (more than or equal to 130m 2 /g) and mesoporous structure (3-10 nm) pore diameter is prepared by regulating and controlling synthesis conditions, such as reaction temperature, dropwise adding speed of metal salt solution and alkali solution, and the like in the process of preparing the magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite by a double-dropwise method. The magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite material and the preparation method thereof are suitable for catalyst carriers or catalysts, harmful gas adsorbents and the like in heterogeneous catalysis due to large specific surface area, and in addition, the preparation method has simple process, convenient operation and no need of adding surfactant, thereby having industrial production and application prospects.

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Electro-optic device and electronic apparatus
abstract: To provide an electro-optic device in which electrical damage caused when a contact hole is formed is reduced.SOLUTION: A scanning line 241 and a gate electrode 232 of a first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a first contact hole 276A, the scanning line 241 and the gate electrode 232 of a second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a second contact hole 276B, the scanning line 241 and a first light-shielding layer 254A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a third contact hole 275A, the scanning line 241 and a second light-shielding layer 254B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fourth contact hole 275B, the first light-shielding layer 254A and the gate electrode 232 of the first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fifth contact hole 280, and the second light-shielding layer 254B and the gate electrode 232 of the second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a sixth contact hole 281.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Semiconductor device manufacturing method, semiconductor device, and semiconductor apparatus
abstract: A manufacturing method for a semiconductor device according to the present disclosure includes preparing a laminate body 10 including a plurality of semiconductor layers 11, 12, and 13, and a first support body 20 including an upper surface 20a, a side surface 20b, and a recessed portion 21 including an opening adjacent to the upper surface 20a and the side surface 20b, bonding and disposing the laminate body 10 to the upper surface 20a of the first support body 20, forming a first end surface 10a at the laminate body 10, and forming a first dielectric layer 17 on the first end surface 10a.

title: Semiconductor device and semiconductor device manufacturing method
abstract: To provide a semiconductor device for performing high-performance active operation and a semiconductor device manufacturing method that can easily manufacture the semiconductor device.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device (electromagnetic wave detection device) includes a substrate 11, an active element (rectifying element 12) which is formed on the substrate, has a semiconductor layer and a first element end and a second element end, and performs an active operation between the first element end and the second element end, a first electrode (cathode electrode 13) which is formed on the substrate and connected to the first element end of the active element, a second electrode (anode electrode 14) formed on the substrate away from the active element, a support rod 18 which is formed on a region between the active element and the second electrode on the substrate, and made of the same semiconductor material as the semiconductor layer of the active element, and a wiring portion 17 which is supported by the support rod and is bridged and wired between the second element end of the active element and the second electrode while passing through the support rod.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Sensor film structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a sensor film structure and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the structure comprises: a substrate, a first insulating layer, and a device layer. The substrate is provided with a first surface and a second surface opposite to the first surface, wherein a cavity is formed on the first surface, an opening is formed on the second surface, and the cavity is communicated with the opening. The cavity and the opening penetrate through the substrate along a direction perpendicular to the first surface. The first insulating layer is arranged on the first surface of the substrate. The device layer is disposed on the first insulating layer.

title: Can accomodate formula electronic information communication equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a storable electronic information communication device, which comprises a box body, universal wheels, a control switch, a power line, a heat dissipation fan, a clamping groove and a box cover, wherein auxiliary fixing devices are horizontally and oppositely arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of a bearing plate, a driving mechanism is arranged at the right end of a first shell, the driving mechanism drives a connecting rod group to drive a fixing plate to move through a rotary plate and a first sliding block, so that the fixing plate is abutted against the outer surface of the communication device, the effect of auxiliary fixing of the communication device is achieved, and the collision and damage of the communication device are prevented.

title: Thing flow box convenient to use
abstract: The utility model discloses a thing flow box convenient to use relates to commodity circulation technical field. This thing flow box convenient to use, one side welding that the cylinder groove was kept away from to the bottom of first telescopic link has the wheel piece of stopping, and its top activity is inlayed and is equipped with the second telescopic link, and one side welding that first telescopic link was kept away from to the second telescopic link has the pull rod, one side welding that fourth plate internal surface is close to the third plate has the block. This thing flow box convenient to use, for the convenience of carrying, the bottom plate fixed mounting of thing flow box has the pulley, the side-mounting has embedded flexible pull rod to make its transportation more labour saving and time saving and do not account for the space, article are got for better dress, the opposite side sets up buckle device, make it can open and get its article of not just getting, two junction screwed connection of thing flow box have the hinge, the better plate that opens and shuts, and the air duct has been seted up on the positive surface left side of thing flow box, the case adsorbs with the case mutually when preventing the thing flow box stack, be difficult to take out the thing flow box.

title: Ceiling type communication base station
abstract: The utility model discloses a ceiling type communication base station, including mounting panel, drum, drive assembly, box body, base station body and sliding plate, the drum has a holding chamber, and its lateral part symmetry has seted up spacing opening. The driving assembly comprises an electric telescopic rod fixedly connected with the mounting plate, a toothed column arranged on an output shaft of the electric telescopic rod, incomplete gears symmetrically meshed with the toothed column and connecting rod transmission units, and the incomplete gears are fixedly connected with each connecting rod transmission unit positioned outside the cylinder. The box body is positioned below the cylinder and is provided with two parallel sliding chutes. The base station body is arranged in the box body, the sliding plate is positioned in the sliding groove and is in sliding connection with the sliding groove, and the connecting rod transmission unit is rotationally connected with the sliding plate. And adjusting the electric telescopic rod to enable the connecting rod transmission unit to move to realize the descending/ascending of the box body. When the base station needs to be maintained, the driving assembly is adjusted to enable the base station body to descend to a proper height, and fault processing is carried out. The working efficiency of maintainers is improved.

title: Indoor rack convenient to equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of indoor cabinets and discloses an indoor cabinet convenient to assemble, which comprises a connecting piece, wherein a first mounting groove is formed in the bottom of the connecting piece, a front panel is movably connected to the inner surface of the first mounting groove, a second mounting groove is formed in one side of the connecting piece, a side plate is movably connected to the inner surface of the second mounting groove, a third mounting groove is formed in the top of the connecting piece, a top plate is movably connected to the inner surface of the third mounting groove, a back plate is arranged at the rear end of the bottom of the top plate, a dehumidifying box is arranged on the front surface of the back plate, so that better use experience is provided for users through rapid assembly of the inner cabinet, the waiting installation time is shortened, the inner cabinet can be started to be used more quickly, the installation is simple and convenient, the working efficiency is improved, faults such as circuit short circuits and the like caused by overhigh humidity are avoided, the stability of equipment operation is improved, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title: Antistatic combined tool box
abstract: The utility model discloses an antistatic combined tool box, which comprises a box body, wherein the top surface of the box body is rotationally connected with a cover plate, one side of the box body is provided with a table plate, electrostatic fans are fixedly arranged on the surfaces of two sides of the box body, the table plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of one side of the box body through a folding assembly, and the table plate can be unfolded by the folding assembly to provide an operation platform for the tool box. The technical effects achieved are as follows: an operation platform can be unfolded through the folding assembly, so that workers can conveniently conduct working operation outdoors.

title: User equipment
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method, user equipment, and a base station for implementing beam failure recovery within a random access procedure and contributing to automatic network optimization related to synchronization signal blocks and reference signals. SOLUTION: In a wireless communication system 10, user equipment 200 transmits beam failure-related information indicating the execution status of a random access procedure to a network NG-RAN 20.
