title: Communication method, apparatus and system
abstract: A communication method, apparatus and system. The method comprises: acquiring first configuration information, and on the basis of the first configuration information, sending L sensing signals, wherein the first configuration information is used for indicating M CDM groups, each of the M CDM groups comprises a plurality of ports, the L sensing signals correspond to the plurality of ports in at least one of the M CDM groups, and L is a positive integer less than or equal to M. A plurality of ports included in at least one CDM group is configured, such that sensing signals are sent via the plurality of ports, thereby improving the communication performance and sensing performance, and improving spatial-domain gain.

title: Adaptation of spatial reuse for extremely high throughput
abstract: This disclosure describes systems, methods, and devices related to spatial reuse for extremely high throughput (EHT). A device may identify a frame received from a first station device configured to operate in a first basic service set (BSS) on a first channel. The device may analyze a preamble of the frame to determine a classification of the frame. The device may adjust a calculation of a packet detection for overlapping basic service set (OBSS) value based on a number of unpunctured 20 MHz frequency channels. The device may determine to simultaneously use the first channel for communication with a second device within a second BSS based on the calculation of the packet detection for OBSS value.

title: Wireless Communication Device and Corresponding Apparatus, Method and Computer Program
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to wireless communication devices, systems comprising wireless communication devices, and to an apparatus, a method and a computer program for a wireless communication device. The apparatus comprises a transceiver module for transmitting and receiving wireless transmissions. The apparatus comprises a processing module that is configured to control the transceiver module. The processing module is configured to communicate with a further wireless communication device via the transceiver module. The communication with the further wireless communication device is based on a transmission of data frames between the wireless communication device and the further wireless communication device. Each data frame is based on a two-dimensional grid in a time-frequency plane having a time dimension resolution and a frequency dimension resolution. The processing module is configured to select a communication mode from a plurality of communication modes for the communication between the wireless communication device and the wireless communication device. The communication mode defines a combination of a frequency dimension resolution and a time dimension resolution of the two-dimensional grid in the time-frequency plane. The processing module is configured to negotiate a communication mode of the plurality of communication modes to select for a future communication between the wireless communication device and the further wireless communication device with the further wireless communication device.

title: Information transmission method and device
abstract: The application provides an information transmission method and device, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for solving the problem that electric quantity is wasted caused by the fact that communication equipment blindly monitors downlink control information at all monitoring occasions. The method comprises the following steps: the communication device determines information of the target beam; determining a target monitoring opportunity according to information of the target beam and a mapping relation between the beam and the monitoring opportunity, wherein the target monitoring opportunity is positioned in a system information window, and the system information window is used for OSI; and monitoring downlink control information at the target monitoring opportunity. The method and the device are suitable for the process of information transmission between the network equipment and the communication equipment.

title: Intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment, which relates to the technical field of high-altitude equipment management and has the technical scheme that the intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system comprises the following main points of collecting operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment and dividing the condition area of the high-altitude equipment into area division groups according to the operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment; the regional division set comprises a target fault region, a first region to be divided and a second region to be divided, an initial steering state of the detection device is set according to the position relation of the regional division set, the initial steering state of the detection device and condition data in the target fault region are processed, analyzed and set to be the initial working state of the detection device, the regional coverage range of the target fault region towards the direction of the detection device is collected, and the parameter fluctuation trend of high-altitude equipment is obtained in real time.

title: Evaluation system, method, device, equipment and medium for cloud control basic platform regulation instruction
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an evaluation system, a method, a device, equipment and a medium of a cloud control basic platform regulation instruction, wherein in the system, a road end subsystem comprises a road end time information acquisition module used for transmitting acquired road end time information to an instruction evaluation subsystem, a cloud end subsystem comprises a data acquisition module used for transmitting cloud end time information and external data to the instruction evaluation subsystem, a vehicle end subsystem comprises a vehicle end time information acquisition module used for transmitting acquired vehicle end time information to the instruction evaluation subsystem, the instruction evaluation subsystem is used for acquiring the road end time information, cloud end time information and vehicle end time information, aligning the road end time information, the cloud end time information and the vehicle end time information with the time information of the instruction evaluation subsystem, calculating the value of a regulation instruction evaluation index according to the time information of each subsystem after alignment, and the reliability of a regulation instruction evaluation result is improved by adopting the technical scheme.

title: Outdoor inspection method and equipment
abstract: The application provides an outdoor inspection method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current position through an intelligent inspection terminal, and determining the position of a next inspection point to be detected currently based on the determined shortest inspection route; guiding a user to go to the next inspection point based on the current position and the position of the next inspection point and a navigation route with shortest time or shortest path generated by the terrain environment; correlating the ground inspection data acquired by the intelligent inspection terminal with the identification of the current inspection point to generate inspection data; uploading inspection data to a cloud server through an intelligent inspection terminal; if the intelligent patrol terminal detects that the self electric quantity is lower than a preset threshold value and/or the current weather environment accords with a preset abnormal condition, preset early warning information is sent to the cloud server; and if the gesture data detected by the intelligent patrol terminal accords with the preset dangerous condition of the user, executing a preset recourse flow. The application realizes intelligent inspection.

title: Gate hoist intelligent control system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent control system of a gate hoist, which relates to the technical field of automatic control and solves the technical problems that the gate control efficiency is low because the working environment of a gate is not considered and the linkage control with the surrounding environment cannot be realized in the gate control process in the prior art; according to the intelligent gate control system, the environment data of a target area in a gate distribution diagram are analyzed to obtain an environment tag, the environment tag and the water level data are combined to generate an intelligent regulation strategy, and after the intelligent terminal verifies the intelligent regulation strategy, the driving motor is controlled through the gate controller, so that the intelligent control of the gate is realized, the pressure of workers is reduced, and the control efficiency of the gate is improved; according to the invention, the gate distribution diagram is established through the cloud platform, the relevant data of each gate in the gate distribution diagram is displayed in time, and meanwhile, early warning is carried out in time according to the set early warning condition, so that the state of each gate is conveniently and remotely monitored by workers, a large amount of inspection work is reduced, and the safety is improved.

title: Informationized management method and system for monitoring electrical equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the field of informatization management, and particularly discloses an informatization management method and system for monitoring electrical equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical temperature, historical current, real-time current and real-time temperature of the electrical equipment, obtaining a temperature mutation rate and a current mutation rate of the electrical equipment, and preliminarily determining abnormal electrical equipment; acquiring a monitoring video with the radius of the abnormal electrical equipment as a preset distance, identifying a monitoring target, forming a motion track of the monitoring target, substituting the motion track into a behavior model to obtain an abnormal behavior detection result of the monitoring target, analyzing the monitoring target with the abnormal detection result, and determining a corresponding management strategy. The method comprises the steps of firstly preliminarily determining the abnormal electrical equipment, then checking the images around the abnormal electrical equipment to further determine the monitoring target, then judging the motion trail of the monitoring target, finding out the abnormal reason and carrying out targeted solution, realizing automatic monitoring of the electrical equipment, and being particularly suitable for outdoor power transmission lines.

title: Device for detecting wafer integrity of Centura ACP machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a listen device of centrura ACP board conveying wafer integrality, including laser emitter, laser receiver and the power of being connected with laser emitter and laser receiver, one among laser emitter and the laser receiver is installed the wafer of board bears the weight of the cavity top, and another among laser emitter and the laser receiver is installed the wafer of board bears the weight of the cavity bottom, laser emitter is used for producing a circular shape laser circle or laser ring, laser receiver is used for forming circular or annular response region, laser ring or laser ring with the response region is relative in the ascending position of vertical side, the wafer that the wafer bore the cavity is located laser emitter with between the laser receiver, the laser irradiation of laser emitter transmission is in the edge of wafer. The utility model discloses can carry out real time monitoring to the integrality of wafer in wafer bearing cavity to can effectively avoid wafer broken piece can't be found in the wafer bearing cavity and lead to the board to be forced the condition of shutting down and take place.

title: Use of polypeptide in promotion of cartilage regeneration or repair
abstract: Disclosed is use of a Histatin-1 polypeptide in the promotion of cartilage regeneration or repair. By means of preparing a combined agent containing a Histatin-1 polypeptide, a biological scaffold material, etc., mainly linear Hst1 is loaded on gelatin methacrylate so as to be used for cartilage damage repair or cartilage growth promotion. Further disclosed is the use of the Histatin-1 polypeptide in the promotion of the expression of one or more of bone differentiation indexes, comprising collagen fiber, glycosaminoglycan, type II collagen and aggrecan.

title: Stalk pulling device for tobacco stalk pulling machine
abstract: The utility model relates to a stalk pulling device for a tobacco stalk pulling machine, which relates to the technical field of agricultural mechanical equipment and comprises a connecting shaft and two pulling rods arranged on the connecting shaft, wherein the connecting shaft is used for being connected with the stalk pulling machine, the two pulling rods are oppositely arranged on the connecting shaft and extend forwards, and the distance between the two pulling rods is gradually increased from front to back. The pulling rod machine drives two driving rods to synchronously move when moving forwards, the two driving rods respectively correspond to two groups of tobacco stems, the driving rods extend to the tobacco stems on two adjacent sides, along with the movement of the pulling rod machine, the two driving rods distribute the two groups of tobacco stems to two sides of the pulling rod machine, the tobacco stems generate an outward falling trend under the action of the driving rods, then the tobacco stems are pulled up through a pulling rod mechanism of the pulling rod machine, the tobacco stems fall to two sides of the pulling rod machine under the action of self gravity, the probability of breakage of the tobacco stems is reduced, and meanwhile, the convenience of subsequent collection and picking of the tobacco stems is improved, so that the efficiency of collecting the tobacco stems is improved.

title: Wheel hub of vacuum spoke wheel for electric vehicle
abstract: The utility model discloses a hub of a vacuum spoked wheel for an electric vehicle, which comprises a rim, spokes and a fixing ring, wherein the fixing ring is hollow and is used for being installed in a matching manner with a hub motor of the electric vehicle, fixing heads are arranged on two side edges of the rim in a protruding manner, fixing edges are arranged on two side edges of the fixing ring, one ends of the spokes are installed on the fixing edges, and the other ends of the spokes are installed on the fixing heads which are not on the same side as the fixing edges. Above-mentioned wheel hub of vacuum spoke wheel for electric motor car has designed new-type wheel hub to current electric motor car wheel structure, and the suitability is high, is convenient for install the vacuum child, improves vehicle security to arrange through unique spoke, improved the anti-seismic performance of electric motor car, guarantee the stationarity, whole light has opened up new research and development thinking for the electric motor car trade.

title: Device for preventing freezing on high-voltage line
abstract: The utility model provides a prevent freezing device on high-tension line, relates to distribution power equipment and maintains technical field, the utility model discloses a be equipped with rotatory piece on the cable, be equipped with power generation facility on the rotatory piece, the last bearing that is equipped with of power generation facility, be equipped with rotatory leaf on the bearing, power generation facility is fixed on fixed frame by first dead lever, is equipped with the switch on the fixed frame, is equipped with second dead lever and fourth dead lever in the fixed frame, is equipped with the motor on the cross position of second dead lever and fourth dead lever, is equipped with the flabellum on the motor and so reaches the frost and the rain that scrape cable surface knot and prevent the purpose that freezes on the cable, the utility model discloses rational in infrastructure and practical, easy operation is swift, need not artifical deicing and strikes, thoroughly liberates the manpower, and its low in labor strength has protected workman's safety, has prevented that.
